# Guest cohort corrections, 2026-10-05

Source snapshot: branch `codex/verify-8031-guest-cohorts`, prepared commit `8031ce0db3c61b289512f270ae594a197d055c15`. This packet is source only. The author ran no project imports, tests, compiler, linter, generator, services or containers. Root execution and independent review are required.

The accepted machine executor correctly returns `grant_mismatch` when a grant belongs to another workspace. Health telemetry now classifies that unchanged authorization error as inaccessible, alongside `denied`, instead of presenting an unreadable scope as an ordinary unknown read. It retains the original code. The existing refusal case checks that the driver never executes, no credential session opens, and the rejection is still audited. Additional direct telemetry controls keep unsupported and ordinary driver failures unknown. No privilege fallback, grant widening or error rewriting is introduced.

The file-write admission fixture no longer asserts that `package.install` is absent from the typed operation vocabulary, after its implementation was accepted. Each write, upload and package payload still requires its own closed metadata schema. The fixture checks six cross-operation payload substitutions refuse and preserves all existing hostile file contents, noncanonical path, uncertainty and evidence controls. Vocabulary admission is not proof that a default guest currently advertises or can execute an operation; local profile, signed scope and native helper eligibility remain required.

Preview entries in the offered capability catalog now derive a top-level explanation from the existing preview cells' evidence reasons. Their support level, lifecycle flags, runtime limitations and provider evidence are unchanged. The entry schema refuses a preview entry with no explanation, as cell and unsupported-entry schemas already do. The added catalog control proves that AWS network remains preview, its runtime path remains unsupported, missing or empty reasons refuse, and preview explanations retain their real cell caveats.

`src/lib/offered-catalog/offered-catalog.json` is reserved for root generation using the unchanged canonical `scripts/docs/offered-catalog.ts` generator. This packet preserves that historical artifact bytewise and does not hand-edit its digest, version, entries or reasons. Before importing this stricter schema into a running product or executing catalog tests, root must regenerate and review the artifact, verify all support levels and lifecycle/runtime fields are unchanged, and run the unchanged CLI drift and structural checks. The current historical JSON intentionally remains incompatible with the new missing-rationale rule until that generation occurs.

The service restart/result/golden correction is a separate immutable source packet. Genuine Linux service golden generation, native mandatory registration and installed systemd/default-guest proof remain separate. Existing native 127 events, three exact optionals and packaged-worker 22 obligations are unchanged here. Historical baseline failures and skipped native prerequisites remain visible; these models do not promote runtime acceptance.
